text:
maria: Heads-up: CI started failing on the nightly kernel-matrix after I landed the attention-kernel selection RFC follow-up. Binary sizes for the fatbin artifacts jumped ~2.3x on a few archs. Not sure if LTO or our new -gencode set is the culprit.

ajay: ugh. which flags did you add?

maria: I added per-RFC:
```
NVCC_FLAGS += -O3 -lineinfo -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 \
             -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 \
             -gencode arch=compute_90,code=sm_90 \
             -Xcompiler -fvisibility=hidden -Xlinker -s
# also enabling LTO from toolchain config
```

kai: LTO + multiple fatbins can explode because NVCC will emit multiple PTX/CUBIN combos and the linker keeps them. Also -lineinfo keeps a lot of debug metadata.

sophia: did the size jump correlate with a specific nvcc version? we've seen nvcc 12.x produce larger fatbins than 11.x for mixed arch lists.

maria: repro on my local: nvcc 12.2 increases .fatbin by ~2x vs 11.8 for same source.

ajay: we should gate on both nvcc version and resulting artifact size in CI. fast fix: disable LTO for now and strip lineinfo for release builds.

ci-bot: nightly/kernel-matrix linux-nvcc-12.2 sm86 job failed size-gate (artifact: runtime_fatbin.so, 68.3MB, threshold 32MB)

buildcop: filing playbook note: tag affected builds and attach nvcc verbose output.

maria: repro script I ran:
```bash
set -e
for V in 11.8 12.1 12.2; do
  docker run --rm -v $PWD:/src cuda:${V}-base /bin/bash -lc "cd /src && nvcc -v -o a.o -c kernel.cu \"$NVCC_FLAGS\""
  size a.o || true
done
```

kai: also watch PTX version emitted. NVCC 12 emits newer PTX that older drivers may JIT and inflate size. `--ptx` output differs. parse `ptxas` header: `// .version 7.5` etc.

ajay: proposal:
- CI matrix expands to include nvcc versions 11.8, 12.1, 12.2 (parallel jobs)
- For each nvcc version, build two artifact variants: `release-min` (strip lineinfo, no LTO, minimal gencode list) and `compat-ptx` (include PTX for highest arch only).
- Run size gate for `release-min` (threshold 35MB) and record sizes for compat builds without failing (warn).
- Add a small script that extracts PTX header versions and SASS size to a JSON blob for the artifact dashboard.

maria: I like that. For gencode we should standardize to: `-gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80` plus one ptx fallback: `-gencode arch=compute_90,code=compute_90` (PTX only) so we get smaller cubins and a PTX fallback for newer archs.

sophia: watch out: some kernels assume sm_90 SASS for specific instructions. PTX fallback won't use those instrinsics and could slow down. we need perf regression tests as part of the matrix.

ajay: agreed. add a perf smoke test that runs 1k tokens of attention with small model and checks latency and output hash tolerance. fail CI only on big regressions.

buildcop: Action items created: BC-482 add nvcc-version build matrix, BC-483 add artifact-size gate (release-min), BC-484 add ptx-version extractor.

maria: quick mitigation landed in branch:
```diff
- NVCC_FLAGS += -O3 -lineinfo -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 \
+ NVCC_FLAGS += -O3 -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 \
+ # disable LTO for now in CI release-min
+ # keep explicit PTX-only entry for compat build
```

kai: will follow-up on long-term: investigate illumos of nvcc LTO + clang LTO interactions and whether we can postprocess fatbins to strip duplicate PTX. there are linker tricks to drop duplicate sections.

sophia: also propose we add a build-time opt-in to generate `*.ptx` sidecar artifacts (for debugging) and compress them in artifacts store. makes nightly diffs easier.

ci-bot: patchset maria/kernel-size-mitigate triggered nightly jobs: 6/6 passed (release-min), compat builds pushed as warnings.

ajay: OK let's ship the mitigation, then schedule a deeper audit on kernels that rely on specific SASS. I'll open an RFC follow-up for a standardized arch policy and our CI targets.

maria: thanks all. I'll pick up BC-482 and BC-483 tomorrow.

buildcop: reminder: add an audit note for reclaiming storage if we keep compat PTX artifacts (cost concern). :money_with_wings:
